name: forge-a-thon-extension
description: TrueForge-powered Flask editing with repository discovery, isolated checks and reviewed patches.

commands.title: Forge: Task A — Propose Selected Function Patch
Forge: Approve and Apply Task A Hunk
Forge: Task B — Discover, Verify and Review

forge.trueforgeBaseUrl.description: TrueForge local or hosted base URL. Do not put secrets in settings.

forge.trueforgeModel.description: Fully-qualified model name already configured in TrueForge. Leave empty to choose from TrueForge's available models.

forge.mcpPort.description: Loopback port for the read-only workspace MCP tools used by TrueForge. Use 0 to request a free port.

forge.taskBContextBudget.description: Estimated repository tokens available for search and read results during one Task B turn.

forge.taskBSearchResultLimit.description: Maximum ranked paths returned by a repository search.

forge.taskBMaxReadLines.description: Maximum source lines returned by one read_file tool call.

forge.taskBMaxToolResultChars.description: Hard character limit for one MCP tool response.

forge.taskBIterationLimit.description: Maximum TrueForge agent iterations for one Task B session.

forge.taskBDeferredTools.description: Use selective TrueForge tool preloading; rare directory browsing remains deferred.

forge.taskBEnableCompaction.description: Enable TrueForge context compaction at 4,400 estimated input tokens. Keep disabled for providers with tight output-token quotas.

forge.taskBToolPaceMs.description: Optional minimum interval between tool responses for models with low input-token rate limits.

forge.taskBFallbackModels.description: Up to two ordered fallback models configured in TrueForge. Rate-limited provider families are skipped; transient network and server failures get one bounded retry.

forge.taskAFallbackModels.description: Ordered TrueForge models used when the Task A provider fails.

forge.providerMaxRetries.description: Maximum transient retries per provider before switching models.

forge.freeOnly.description: Restrict automatic model routing to the configured free-model allowlist. Free-tier availability and quotas depend on the provider account.

forge.taskBMaxInputTokens.description: Estimated per-request input limit including schemas, instructions, history and tool results.

forge.taskBMaxOutputTokens.description: Reserve enough model output tokens for staged patch arguments.

forge.taskBModelContextWindow.description: Conservative model context-window limit used to reserve output capacity.

forge.repoMapEnabled.description: Enable local RepoMap symbol tools over a private tracked-file mirror. Disable to use the existing repository search.

forge.repoMapMaxResults.description: Maximum symbol or relationship results per RepoMap tool call.
